title: Schedule to the Cash Pickup Terms: Window Base of a Late Reactivation
content:
**Schedule.** The window given to a reactivated Cash Pickup pickup is built on a window base. The base follows how late the reactivation comes after the expiry.

**Days late.** The calendar days from the day the pickup expired to the day of the reactivation. The expiry day is not counted.

| Days late | Window base |
|---|---|
| more than 21 | shortened by the day: the tier's pickup window less one day for every day late beyond 7 grace days |
| from 8 up to 21 | the tier's pickup window less a flat 7 days, whatever the exact number of days late |
| fewer than 8 | the full tier pickup window |

Above 21 days late, the base is the tier window less the difference between the days late and 7. The window base is a whole number of calendar days, counted from the day of the reactivation.

## Worked cases (hypothetical 30-day tier window, pickup expired 1 April)

| Reactivated on | Days late | Window base |
|---|---|---|
| 5 April | 4 | 30 |
| 8 April | 7 | 30 |
| 9 April | 8 | 23 |
| 22 April | 21 | 23 |
| 23 April | 22 | 30 less 15, which is 15 |
| 1 May | 30 | 30 less 23, which is 7 |

Between 8 and 21 days late the reduction is always 7 days. From 22 days late the reduction grows by one day for each further day.
